notes.title: Patch 1.0.1
notes.notes:
Patch 1.0.1 (June 24, 2024)

[b]Animations[/b]
- Increased the speed of level completion animations by 15%.
- Pressing R or replaying the current level will now skip the level animations.

[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
- Fixed the 'Speed Boost' obstacle to display correctly (icon 3 cat paw prints).
- Fixed the cat path image (cat icon) to display correctly on paths that can overlap.

[b]Additional Improvements[/b]
- Added shortcuts for all sections except the 'Settings' page.
- Improved the settings window for easier use.
- Enhanced the flexibility of background images when using custom window mode.
- Slightly improved the clarity of the UI.

This update not only fixes display errors but also includes other improvements to enhance the player's experience during gameplay.

Thank you for all the feedback and suggestions.
